title: Role create API persists templateId and viewMode columns
steps:
1. POST /api/roles with payload including name, fePermissions[], viewMode='tech', and templateId='system-foreman'.
2. Inspect response status and body.
3. GET the created role by ID via the list/view endpoint.
4. Inspect templateId, viewMode in the returned RoleViewOutputDto.
expected: Create returns 201 (or 200 per local convention). Subsequent GET returns templateId='system-foreman' and viewMode='tech' on the role DTO.
